steps.expected: The Emids logo, primary heading, and primary call-to-action are visible.

steps.action: Check the loaded page for visible failure messages.
steps.expected: The main content is visible and no page-not-found, critical-error, or failed-load message appears.

test_cases.title: Main navigation opens the correct pages

steps.action: Open the Emids homepage and main navigation.
steps.expected: The main navigation is visible and available.

steps.action: Select each main menu and its mapped destination: Solutions, Capabilities, Industries, Insights, and Company.
steps.expected: Each selected menu expands and its destination link is visible and operable.
The mapped URL and main page content load without a visible page error.

test_cases.title: Primary call-to-action buttons open expected destinations

steps.action: Open the Emids homepage containing the primary calls to action.
steps.expected: The homepage and its primary links are available.

steps.action: Select See How We Deliver Outcomes, See the model, All solutions, Explore Payer, and Connect individually.
steps.expected: Each call-to-action is visible and operable.

steps.action: Review the destination opened by each call-to-action.
steps.expected: Each assigned URL and its main content load without a visible error.

test_cases.title: Website remains visible and usable in mobile view

steps.action: Set the browser to a 390 by 844 mobile viewport and open the Emids homepage.
Review the mobile logo, primary text, hero image, call-to-action, and menu control.
steps.expected: The content is visible and the menu control is enabled.

steps.action: Open the mobile navigation and expand its Solutions section.
steps.expected: All primary navigation controls are visible, Solutions expands, and its content is accessible.

steps.action: Review the page width at the mobile viewport.
steps.expected: No content extends horizontally beyond the viewport.

test_cases.title: Contact form validates empty required fields

steps.action: Open the Emids contact form with every required field empty.
steps.expected: All eight required fields are present and empty.
The user remains on the contact page and the form is not accepted.

steps.action: Review validation feedback for every required field.
steps.expected: Every required field is marked invalid and exposes a clear field-specific validation message.
